name: Tales in Distress
source:
An adventure game set in a fantasy world ruled by sword and magic.
Sisters go to fight off the bandits to save their native village; however, they get a counterattack and become captive.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057382.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
设定在剑与魔法的奇幻世界的冒险游戏。
姐妹们前去击退山贼以拯救她们的家乡，但遭到了反击，成为了俘虏。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE057382.html]DLSite English[/url]]
